description: For each connected account over the last `days` (default 7): comments received, public replies and automated DMs sent, new contacts and emails captured, each against the window before, plus its top 3 posts. days.description: How many days back. Default 7, up to 90.

profile_ids.description: Limit to these accounts. Omit for every account this connection can see.
